title: Quickstart microinteractions, step icons, and responsive hero refresh
creator: Ana Singh
description: Scope: Refresh the Quickstart landing experience with a focus on three pillars: 1) Responsive hero variants (mobile/desktop/wide) that surface a concise onboarding path and product screenshots, 2) A compact SVG step-icon library (glyphs + state variants) for the 3-step flow used across docs and console, 3) Microinteraction patterns (hover, focus, progress transitions, and streaming/typing states) to increase clarity and perceived performance. Goal is production-ready Figma components, developer-ready assets (SVGs, Lottie snippets for microinteractions where applicable), annotated screenshot packs for marketing and docs, and accessibility-aligned color/token guidance. Deliverables will be CDN-ready assets, a small animation spec, and a handoff package for frontend implementation with token names and CSS snippets.
acceptance_criteria: Hero: 3 responsive breakpoints (mobile <=420px, tablet 421-1024px, desktop >1024px) implemented as Figma variants with annotated spacing/grid tokens
Icons: 12 step icons + 3 state overlays (default, active, complete) exported as optimized SVGs and symbolized in Figma components
Microinteractions: 4 interaction specs (CTA hover, step progress fill, streaming typing cursor, screenshot reveal) documented with timing/duration and Lottie or CSS examples
Accessibility: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text and >=3:1 for UI elements; focus-visible styles defined and included in handoff
Dev Handoff: assets folder with filenames, usage examples, and a short QA checklist; at least one implementation PR referenced in attachments
